title: Two-weight commutators for the Bessel Riesz transform with Andersen--Kerman weights
summary: Let $α>-1/2$, $α\ne0$, and let $$ Δ_α=-\frac{d^2}{dx^2}-\frac{2α}{x}\frac{d}{dx} $$ be the Bessel operator on $\mathbb R_+=(0,\infty)$. We characterize boundedness and compactness of commutators of $R_α=\frac{d}{dx}Δ_α^{-1/2}$ on the Andersen--Kerman two-weight setting. For $1<p<\infty$ and $μ,λ\in A_{p,α}$, put $ ν=\left(\fracμλ\right)^{1/p}, \ dρ_α(x)=x^{2α+1}\,dx. $ For real-valued symbols, $$ \|[b,R_α]\|_{L^p(μ\,dx)\to L^p(λ\,dx)} \simeq \|b\|_{\rm{BMO}_{ν,α}}, $$ where the Bloom oscillation is computed with respect to $dρ_α$.
